title: Administrative action on a checker configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. Choose checker states $q,q'$, natural numbers $i,j,r,s$ with $i,j\le |x|$, signs $m,d\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and an optional bit $b$. Suppose moving the input head from position $i+1$ by $m$ gives position $j+1$, and $(r-1)+d=s-1$. Applying the administrative action with these movements, output $b$, and successor state $q'$ to the checker configuration indexed by $c,q,i,r$ yields the checker configuration indexed by $c,q',j,s$, except that its output is $b$ when present and empty otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$x$ is a Boolean word and $c$ is a configuration on $x$
the clamped input-head move from $i+1$ by $m$ reaches $j+1$
replaced:
Applying an administrative action with compatible input-head and
countdown-head moves to a length-checker configuration yields the checker
configuration with the correspondingly updated input position and countdown
counter, with output equal to the action's optional emission and all work
tapes unchanged.
